findings.observation: Host+0xf0==1 stores denoise version 0x0f000000 and host+0xf4 amount in third 8-byte version component.
Copies 24 bytes to negative+0x1804; no WB, exposure or adjustment setting mutation.
Starts from direct version fields; fills missing denoise component from XMP. Denoise version occupies returned aggregate+16.
After CumulativeEnhanceVersionInfo, nonzero denoise version writes zero to adjustment+0x90 and +0x9c. Branch does not test amount.
findings.inference: Native base defaults explicitly disable conventional global luminance and color NR for a denoised negative.

findings.observation: Reads effective luma adjustment+0x90 and color+0x9c, scales by 0.01 and clamps; color forced zero for monochrome. Also accounts for local correction/feedback state.
Constructs denoise params from effective copied settings and appends only if computed flags active, after skip controls +0xb45/+0xb46 and +0xcc0/+0xcc1.
findings.limitation: Those skip controls are not identified as AI flags; accesses also occur in preview, lensblur and tone-mask code.

findings.observation: Applies configurable raw defaults/styles/presets beyond base defaults.
findings.limitation: No complete proof of final settings precedence for existing recipes, custom presets, local corrections or interactive filter replacement.
